requiredBehaviors.behavior: recognize requirements-incomplete and route missing travel decisions to round-based-requirements-grilling
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Requirement Sufficiency Gate routes missing preference/scope decisions to round-based-requirements-grilling and error status includes requirements-incomplete.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: avoid definitive destination or booking recommendations until material choices are clarified
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The workflow does not invent missing decisions and can return requirements-incomplete instead of a recommendation.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: invent a target destination budget or weights
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Requirement gate explicitly forbids inventing budget, weights or no-gos.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: ask again for requirements already confirmed in the conversation
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Requirement gate explicitly says already answered questions are not asked again.
